plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} knew every row in the fields by heart. I'll {GOAL}, starting with the rows {NAME} planted.
Whatever else happens here, people have to eat. I mean to be the reason they do. Four hundred harvests.
[sparked] I keep thinking about how close we've come to eating raw rice out of the sack. Never again, not while I can hold a hoe.
[spring] The ground's soft and warm again. This is the year I fill the storeroom myself.
[tribal] My mother could read the soil like a face. Before my hands give out, I'll read it as well as she did.

warm.li: A full storeroom means nobody goes hungry. I'd like to be the one who fills it.

cheerful.li: Four hundred harvests! I'll grow so much food we'll have to build another storeroom.

gloomy.li: Any crop can fail, and one year one will. I'll plant more than we need, every season.

cold.li: Food production is the foundation of everything else here. I intend to master it.

plain.li: My hands are rough as bark now, and there's dirt under my nails that will never wash out.
[winter] The fields are under snow, but the storeroom is full, and most of it came through my hands.

warm.li: Every meal at that table started in my fields. That's a good thing to know.

gloomy.li: Four hundred harvests, and the soil still wants more. It always will.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a maker's hands
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: make a hundred and twenty things by hand
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: made a hundred and twenty things by hand

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME}'s tools are still on the bench, worn to the shape of {NAME}'s hands. I'll {GOAL} with them.
Everything here that works, someone made. I want a hundred and twenty of those things to be mine.
[sparked] I've no excuses left. I'll make things until my hands ache.
[medieval] Every village has its maker, the one people go to when something breaks. Ours is going to be me.

warm.li: I like knowing that the things people use every day came from my bench.

blunt.li: A hundred and twenty things. Good ones. Starting now.

cheerful.li: I'm going to make so many things! Useful ones, mostly.

cold.li: A colony runs on its tools and gear. Making them is the most useful work there is.

plain.li: Someone brought me a chair to mend today, and it was one of mine.
[work:Crafting] I finished another one today, and then counted. That was a hundred and twenty.

warm.li: Half the gear in this colony passed through my hands. I hope it serves them well.

blunt.li: Done. My hands are tired, and I've already started the next one.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a fighter up close
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: become someone nobody wants to face up close

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} held the door with nothing but a blade and nerve. I'll {GOAL}, the way {NAME} was.
[spark:battle] They got too close yesterday, and I wasn't good enough. Next time I will be.
[spark:downed] I went down in the mud with a raider on top of me. I'm never going down like that again.
I want raiders to see me coming and pick someone else.

blunt.li: Up close is where I'm best. Soon I'll be the best there is.

cheerful.li: I'll practice until I can knock the knife out of anyone's hand!

gloomy.li: Someday it'll come down to me and someone with a blade. I'd like to be the one who walks away.

cold.li: At close range, skill decides everything. I intend to have more of it than anyone.

plain.li: I sparred with anyone who'd stand up to me this week. Not one of them laid a hand on me.

blunt.li: Let them come close. I'm ready.

cold.li: Few who reach me will leave. That was the goal.

plain.li: Everyone here is busy or old. I want a best friend, someone to tell secrets to.
[sparked] They all went off without me again. I'm going to find a best friend so I'm never left behind.
[spark:loss] I miss them. I want someone to talk to who'll still be here tomorrow.

cheerful.li: I'm going to have a best friend! We'll have a secret handshake.

gloomy.li: The grown-ups like me because they have to. I want someone to like me who doesn't have to.

plain.li: I have a best friend now. We have a secret place and I'm not telling where it is.

cheerful.li: Best friends forever. We pinky-swore and everything!

gloomy.li: I have a best friend. I hope they don't leave.

plain.li: When I grow up I'm going to be really good at {SKILL}. I'm starting now so I'm ahead.
[sparked] I want to get so good at {SKILL} that the grown-ups come to me with questions.
[inherited] {NAME} was teaching me {SKILL}. I'm going to keep practicing, the way {NAME} showed me.

warm.li: If I get good at {SKILL}, I can help everyone. I want to help.

cheerful.li: I love {SKILL} more than anything, and I'm going to be amazing at it!

cold.li: A child who is good at something is useful. I intend to be useful.

plain.li: I'm good at {SKILL} now. Really good. One of the grown-ups asked me how I did it.

cheerful.li: I did it, I'm good at {SKILL}! Everyone come and watch.

cold.li: My skill in {SKILL} is now worth something. Good.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: growing up
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: grow up and be one of the grown-ups
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: grew up into one of the grown-ups

plain.li: I'm nearly grown. Soon they'll stop sending me to bed early and let me do real work.
[spark:birth] There's a baby now. That makes me one of the big ones, and soon I'll be a grown-up.
[afterraid] They wouldn't let me help when the raiders came. When I'm grown, they'll have to.

cheerful.li: Only a few more birthdays and I'm a grown-up! I'm counting.

gloomy.li: Growing up takes forever. But I'll get there.

plain.li: I'm grown now. It doesn't feel as different as I thought, but they listen to me more.

warm.li: Everyone who looked after me when I was small, thank you. It's my turn now.

cheerful.li: I'm a grown-up! Somebody give me something important to do.

plain.li: My child is grown now, with a life of their own here. I'd like to hold a grandchild before I'm done.
[spark:birth] There's a new baby in the colony. I held it today and kept wishing it were one of my own blood.
[sparked] All this new life about the place has me thinking about what comes after me. Grandchildren, in my case.

warm.li: A grandchild, here, safe. That's all I want from the years I have left.

cheerful.li: I've already whittled a rattle! All I need now is a grandchild.

gloomy.li: I'm running out of time, and my family has to go on. A grandchild would settle it.

plain.li: My grandchild. I held them all afternoon and sang every song I could remember.

warm.li: Three generations under one roof. I never thought I'd see it out here.

cheerful.li: I'm a grandparent! I've already made a toy.

gloomy.li: I've seen my grandchild. Whatever happens now, something of me goes on.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: one more year
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see one more year with the colony

plain.li: I'm old. I don't ask for much now. One more year here, with these people. That'll do.
[spark:downed] I nearly didn't get up this time. I want one more year. Just one.
[spark:loss] Another friend gone. I'd like to see one more spring, and put flowers on the grave when it comes.
[winter] Winters are hard on old bones. Let me see the far side of this one, and a few more seasons after.

warm.li: I'd like another year of these people. Even the loud ones.

cheerful.li: One more year! I've got stories I haven't told yet.

gloomy.li: I can feel it coming. A year more would be enough.

plain.li: Another year. I made it. I'll take whatever comes after as a bonus.

warm.li: A whole year more with all of you. Thank you for every day of it.

gloomy.li: One more year. I didn't think I'd get it.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a legacy of students
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: teach two students to stand on their own
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: taught two students to stand alone

plain.li: Everything I know will die with me unless I teach it. Two students who can carry it on, that's what I need.
[spark:loss] Another one of us gone, and everything they knew with them. Not me. I'll teach.
[inherited] {NAME} wanted to leave students behind and never got the chance. I'll take on two, and tell them about {NAME} too.

warm.li: The young ones deserve to know what I know. It's the best thing I can leave them.

cold.li: Knowledge that isn't passed on is wasted. Two students will do.

plain.li: Two students who can stand on their own. When I'm gone, it won't all go with me.

warm.li: I watched my second student teach someone else today. That's when I knew.

gloomy.li: They know it now. I can go whenever I have to.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a place in the ideoligion
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: take on a role in the ideoligion
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: took on a role in the faith

plain.li: My faith has carried me this far. I'd like to carry it in turn, as one of those who lead it.
[spark:omen] The dream came true, just as I saw it. I think I'm meant to do more for my faith.
[grieving] Only my faith got me through this. I want to stand up for it, properly.

warm.li: Others could find what I've found. A role in the faith would let me help them.

cheerful.li: I'd love to lead the rituals! I already know all the words.

gloomy.li: Someone has to keep the faith alive out here. It might as well be me.

cold.li: A role in the faith carries weight in a colony. I would use it well.

plain.li: I stood before them today with my new role. My voice shook, but they listened.

warm.li: I'll serve the faith and the people in it as well as I can.

cold.li: The role is mine now. There's work to do.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: one ideoligion
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see the whole colony share one ideoligion
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: saw the colony share one faith

plain.li: We live together, eat together and fight together. I'd like us to believe together too.
[spark:loss] At the grave, half of us prayed and half of us didn't know how. That should change.
[newcomer] I've only just arrived, and already I can see who here doesn't know the truth yet. I'll be patient with them.

warm.li: My faith has given me so much. Everyone here should have the chance of it.

blunt.li: One colony, one ideoligion. It's simpler for everyone.

gloomy.li: A colony that doesn't share an ideoligion comes apart when things go wrong.

cold.li: Shared belief makes a colony easier to hold together.

plain.li: Everyone here shares the faith now. At the last ritual, every voice joined in.

warm.li: We're one people now, in every way that matters to me.

cold.li: Unity of belief achieved. It will hold us together.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a place to belong
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: came to feel at home here

plain.li: I live here, but I'm not sure I belong here yet. I'd like to, some day soon.
[spark:Council_Soc_LeftOut] They all went off together and forgot to ask me. I'd like to be someone people remember to ask.
[spark:Council_Granted_SeatsForAll] We all sat at one table tonight, and for a moment it felt like home. I want that every day.
[newcomer] Still the new one. I'd like to wake up one morning and feel like I've always been here.

warm.li: These people could be my people. I think I'm close to feeling it.

gloomy.li: I've never really belonged anywhere. Maybe here could be different.

cold.li: A bed in this colony isn't enough. I mean to have a place in it.

plain.li: I came home from the fields today and someone had kept my seat. I'm home.

warm.li: These are my people. I don't have to wonder about it anymore.

gloomy.li: I belong somewhere. I'm still getting used to how that feels.

plain.li: Same walls, same work, same faces. I want my days to feel like they're mine again.
[spark:Council_Granted_Travel] Out on the road I remembered what it's like to breathe. I want to feel that here, too.
[spark:Council_Granted_CampEvening] Those travelers go where they please. I don't need to leave. I just need to feel I could.
[winter] Shut in all winter. When it ends, I need some room to move.

blunt.li: I'm tired of being told where to be every hour. I want some of my days back.

cheerful.li: A free afternoon under open sky, with no one telling me what to do. That's all I'm after!

gloomy.li: I feel like I'm in a cage I helped build. I want out of it, without leaving.

plain.li: Ten days of my own time, open sky and work I chose. I feel like myself again.

cheerful.li: I'm free as a bird, and the bird lives here!

gloomy.li: Free. Someone will take it back eventually, and until then I'm out in the sun.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: an idea taken up
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: have an idea chosen by the council
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: had an idea chosen by the council

plain.li: I have ideas for this colony. One day the council will pick one of mine, and I'll be there to see it.
[spark:Council_DecidedWithoutMe] They decided without me again. Next time it'll be my idea they choose.
[spark:Council_HeardAtMeeting] I listened to everyone pitch their plans tonight. I can do better than half of them.

warm.li: I'd like to give something back. An idea everyone here works on together would do it.

blunt.li: I'm going to pitch until they listen.

cheerful.li: I've got ideas stacked up like firewood! One of them has to win.

cold.li: The council sets the colony's course. I intend to set some of it.

plain.li: The council chose my idea. Now everyone's working on something I thought of.

warm.li: They listened. Now I'd better make sure it works.

cheerful.li: They picked mine! I'm going to be unbearable about this.

cold.li: My proposal was adopted. As it should have been.
